step.script: For a projectile launched and landing at the same height, range depends on launch speed and angle.

ops.content: Projectile range: same launch and landing height

step.script: At fixed speed, the sine factor controls the range as the launch angle changes.

checkpoint.question: Which angle makes the sine factor, and therefore the range, largest?

step.script: Angles below forty-five degrees rise toward maximum range, while larger angles descend symmetrically.
Thus forty-five degrees gives the greatest horizontal range when launch and landing heights match.

ops.content: Assumption: no air resistance; equal launch and landing heights
